decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for two single-storey rear extensions to the rear of these two dwellinghouses, because of their position, design and appearance of the two extensions, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of numbers 131 and 133 Popes Lane and would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original dwellinghouses and the character of the street scene, to the amenities of the parkland, neighbouring properties or the character of the Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area.  The development is in accordance with the UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development),  H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations),  ENVN 1.7 (Development near the Metropolitan Land Boundary) and T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is  compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing buildings.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to both single family dwellinghouses.
